question: The sensor is not found, what's wrong?

findings.title: GND is not connected to GND
findings.explanation: bme280_1 GND does not reach the microcontroller. The esp32-devkitc profile expects gnd on GND.
findings.fix: Add a wire from B41 to RAIL_TOP_MINUS (esp32_1 GND)

findings.title: No I2C device found on the bus
findings.explanation: The microcontroller reports an empty I2C bus but the image shows the expected wiring. A wire may not be seated, or the camera may have mis-read a wire end.
findings.fix: Reseat the SDA, SCL and VIN wires, then rescan
